instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: API, supply chain and cloud-native vulnerabilities
topic_ar: ثغرات الـAPI وسلسلة التوريد والسحابة الأصلية

questions.question: Why have APIs become the main security concern in microservice estates?
questions.question_ar: ليش صارت الـAPIs الهم الأمني الأساسي ببيئات الخدمات المصغّرة؟
options: Because they bypass the need for authentication.
Because they are now the primary interface for business logic.
Because they replace the database in most designs.
Because they are always exposed to the public internet.
options_ar: لأنها صارت الواجهة الأساسية لمنطق الأعمال.
لأنها تستبدل قاعدة البيانات بمعظم التصاميم.
لأنها مكشوفة دائماً على الإنترنت العام.
options_en: Because they bypass the need for authentication.
Because they are now the primary interface for business logic.
Because they replace the database in most designs.
Because they are always exposed to the public internet.
questions.explanation: Once business logic moves behind APIs, those endpoints become the surface an attacker actually talks to.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد ما ينتقل منطق الأعمال ورا الـAPIs، تلك النقاط تصير السطح اللي يتكلّم معه المهاجم فعلاً.

questions.question: What is broken object-level authorization?
questions.question_ar: شنو انكسار التخويل على مستوى الكائن؟
options: A user receives more fields than the page needs.
A user calls an endpoint that no longer exists.
A user reaches an object they are not authorised for.
A user authenticates with a stolen password.
options_ar: مستخدم يستلم حقولاً أكثر من حاجة الصفحة.
مستخدم يستدعي نقطة ما عادت موجودة.
مستخدم يوصل لكائن غير مخوّل له.
options_en: A user receives more fields than the page needs.
A user calls an endpoint that no longer exists.
A user reaches an object they are not authorised for.
A user authenticates with a stolen password.
questions.explanation: The request is legitimate and the identity is valid, but the application never checks that this object belongs to this principal.
questions.explanation_ar: الطلب شرعي والهوية صحيحة، بس التطبيق ما يتحقّق أبداً إن هذا الكائن يخص هذا المستخدم.

questions.question: Why does requesting another user's order by identifier succeed under BOLA?
questions.question_ar: ليش طلب طلبية مستخدم ثاني بالمعرّف ينجح تحت BOLA؟
options: Because ownership of the object is never checked.
Because the identifier is encrypted incorrectly.
Because the session cookie has expired already.
Because the database has no primary keys.
options_ar: لأن ملكية الكائن ما تُفحص أبداً.
لأن قاعدة البيانات بلا مفاتيح أساسية.
options_en: Because ownership of the object is never checked.
Because the identifier is encrypted incorrectly.
Because the session cookie has expired already.
Because the database has no primary keys.
questions.explanation: Changing the identifier in the path is enough, because the endpoint trusts the caller without asking whether the record is theirs.
questions.explanation_ar: تغيير المعرّف بالمسار يكفي، لأن النقطة تثق بالمتصل بلا ما تسأل هل السجل يخصه.

questions.question: What is excessive data exposure?
questions.question_ar: شنو الكشف المفرط عن البيانات؟
options: The API returns data belonging to another user.
The API returns an error with a stack trace.
The API returns nothing at all when called.
The API returns more data than the client needs.
options_ar: الـAPI ترجّع خطأً مع تتبّع مكدّس.
الـAPI ما ترجّع شي أبداً عند الاستدعاء.
الـAPI ترجّع بيانات أكثر من حاجة العميل.
options_en: The API returns data belonging to another user.
The API returns an error with a stack trace.
The API returns nothing at all when called.
The API returns more data than the client needs.
questions.explanation: The endpoint serialises the whole internal object and trusts the front end to hide the extra fields, which anyone can read directly.
questions.explanation_ar: النقطة تُسلسل الكائن الداخلي كله وتترك للواجهة إخفاء الحقول الزايدة، وأي أحد يقدر يقرأها مباشرة.

questions.question: How does excessive data exposure differ from BOLA?
questions.question_ar: كيف يختلف الكشف المفرط عن BOLA؟
options: BOLA affects databases; exposure affects only the UI.
BOLA is an authorization failure; exposure is a filtering failure.
BOLA is a filtering failure; exposure is an authorization failure.
Both are the same defect described with different words.
options_ar: BOLA يصيب قواعد البيانات؛ والكشف يصيب الواجهة فقط.
BOLA فشل تخويل؛ والكشف المفرط فشل تصفية.
BOLA فشل تصفية؛ والكشف المفرط فشل تخويل.
options_en: BOLA affects databases; exposure affects only the UI.
BOLA is an authorization failure; exposure is a filtering failure.
BOLA is a filtering failure; exposure is an authorization failure.
Both are the same defect described with different words.
questions.explanation: In BOLA the user should not have the record at all, while in excessive exposure they may own it but receive fields they should never see.
questions.explanation_ar: بـ BOLA المفروض المستخدم ما يحصل السجل أصلاً، أما بالكشف المفرط فقد يكون السجل له لكن يستلم حقولاً ما لازم يشوفها.

questions.question: Which controls mitigate API vulnerabilities?
questions.question_ar: أي ضوابط تخفّف ثغرات الـAPI؟
options: Parameterised queries and stored procedures.
SameSite cookies and anti-CSRF tokens.
Schema validation, strong auth and rate limiting.
Output encoding, CSP headers and sanitisation.
options_ar: التحقّق من المخطط ومصادقة قوية وتحديد المعدّل.
options_en: Parameterised queries and stored procedures.
SameSite cookies and anti-CSRF tokens.
Schema validation, strong auth and rate limiting.
Output encoding, CSP headers and sanitisation.
questions.explanation: API governance combines schema validation, strong authentication and rate limiting, with gateways adding anomaly detection.
questions.explanation_ar: حكامة الـAPI تجمع التحقّق من المخطط والمصادقة القوية وتحديد المعدّل، والبوّابات تضيف كشف الشذوذ.

questions.question: What do API gateways increasingly add beyond validation?
questions.question_ar: شنو تضيف بوّابات الـAPI عادةً بعد التحقّق؟
options: Anomaly detection to prevent abuse.
Compression to reduce bandwidth.
Caching to reduce database load.
Versioning to manage deprecation.
options_en: Anomaly detection to prevent abuse.
Compression to reduce bandwidth.
Caching to reduce database load.
Versioning to manage deprecation.
questions.explanation: Once volume and shape are observed at the gateway, deviations from normal call patterns become detectable there.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد ما يُلاحظ الحجم والشكل عند البوّابة، صار الانحراف عن أنماط الاستدعاء الطبيعية قابلاً للكشف هناك.

questions.question: What does rate limiting protect an API against?
questions.question_ar: من شنو يحمي تحديد المعدّل الـAPI؟
options: Authorization errors on individual objects.
Schema violations in the request body.
Expired certificates on the gateway.
Abuse through volume rather than a single flaw.
options_en: Authorization errors on individual objects.
Schema violations in the request body.
Expired certificates on the gateway.
Abuse through volume rather than a single flaw.
questions.explanation: It caps how much an authenticated caller can consume, which addresses enumeration and scraping that no single request reveals.
questions.explanation_ar: يحدّ شكثر يقدر متصل مصادَق عليه يستهلك، وهذا يعالج الاستنطاق والسحب اللي ما يكشفه طلب واحد.

questions.question: Why are supply chain vulnerabilities described as systemic?
questions.question_ar: ليش ثغرات سلسلة التوريد توصف بأنها نُظُمية؟
options: Because they require physical access to exploit.
Because the risk lives in code you did not write.
Because they affect every system at the same moment.
Because they cannot be detected by any scanner.
options_ar: لأن الخطر يعيش بكود ما كتبته أنت.
لأنها تصيب كل الأنظمة بنفس اللحظة.
لأن أي فاحص ما يقدر يكشفها.
options_en: Because they require physical access to exploit.
Because the risk lives in code you did not write.
Because they affect every system at the same moment.
Because they cannot be detected by any scanner.
questions.explanation: Third-party libraries enter without sufficient vetting, so your assurance is only as good as the assurance of everyone you depend on.
questions.explanation_ar: مكتبات الطرف الثالث تدخل بلا تدقيق كافٍ، فطمأنينتك بقدر طمأنينة كل من تعتمد عليه.

questions.question: How does dependency confusion work?
questions.question_ar: كيف يشتغل تشويش التبعيات؟
options: A container image is rebuilt from an old base.
A certificate expires during the deployment.
A public package impersonates an internal one by name.
A private key is stolen from the build server.
options_ar: صورة حاوية تُعاد من أساس قديم.
حزمة عامة تنتحل اسم حزمة داخلية.
مفتاح خاص يُسرق من سيرفر البناء.
options_en: A container image is rebuilt from an old base.
A certificate expires during the deployment.
A public package impersonates an internal one by name.
A private key is stolen from the build server.
questions.explanation: The package manager resolves the public name first, so the hostile package is pulled instead of the intended internal one.
questions.explanation_ar: مدير الحزم يحلّ الاسم العام أولاً، فتُسحب الحزمة العدائية بدل الداخلية المقصودة.

questions.question: What does malicious package injection mean?
questions.question_ar: شنو يعني حقن حزم خبيثة؟
options: A hostile package is inserted into the dependency chain.
A hostile user is inserted into the admin group.
A hostile rule is inserted into the firewall.
A hostile record is inserted into the database.
options_ar: حزمة عدائية تُدسّ داخل سلسلة التبعيات.
options_en: A hostile package is inserted into the dependency chain.
A hostile user is inserted into the admin group.
A hostile rule is inserted into the firewall.
A hostile record is inserted into the database.
questions.explanation: The build itself carries the attack, so it ships with the product and arrives inside the trust boundary.
questions.explanation_ar: البناء نفسه يحمل الهجوم، فينزل مع المنتج ويوصل داخل حدود الثقة.

questions.question: Which controls does the chapter give for supply chain risk?
questions.question_ar: أي ضوابط يعطيها الفصل لخطر سلسلة التوريد؟
options: Image scanning, policy enforcement and runtime monitoring.
Schema validation, authentication and rate limiting.
Output encoding, CSP and input sanitisation.
Dependency vetting, software composition analysis and pinning.
options_ar: فحص الصور وإنفاذ السياسة والرصد وقت التشغيل.
التحقّق من المخطط والمصادقة وتحديد المعدّل.
ترميز المخرجات و CSP وتعقيم المدخلات.
تدقيق التبعيات وتحليل تركيب البرمجيات وتثبيت النسخ.
options_en: Image scanning, policy enforcement and runtime monitoring.
Schema validation, authentication and rate limiting.
Output encoding, CSP and input sanitisation.
Dependency vetting, software composition analysis and pinning.
questions.explanation: Vetting decides what may enter, composition analysis reveals what already did, and pinning stops it changing underneath you.
questions.explanation_ar: التدقيق يقرّر شنو يُسمح له يدخل، وتحليل التركيب يكشف اللي دخل فعلاً، والتثبيت يمنعه يتغيّر تحتك.

questions.question: Why does version pinning reduce supply chain risk?
questions.question_ar: ليش تثبيت النسخ يقلّل خطر سلسلة التوريد؟
options: Because pinning removes transitive dependencies.
Because a build cannot silently pick another package.
Because pinned versions are automatically patched.
Because pinning encrypts the package download.
options_ar: لأن التثبيت يزيل التبعيات غير المباشرة.
لأن البناء ما يقدر ياخذ حزمة ثانية بصمت.
options_en: Because pinning removes transitive dependencies.
Because a build cannot silently pick another package.
Because pinned versions are automatically patched.
Because pinning encrypts the package download.
questions.explanation: A range specifier lets the resolver choose something new at build time, which is exactly the gap dependency confusion exploits.
questions.explanation_ar: المدى المفتوح يخلي الحلّال يختار شي جديد وقت البناء، وهذا بالضبط الفراغ اللي يستغله تشويش التبعيات.

questions.question: Why does an inventory of dependencies matter for supply chain security?
questions.question_ar: ليش جرد التبعيات مهم لأمن سلسلة التوريد؟
options: Because it satisfies the audit requirement only.
Because it encrypts every transitive dependency.
Because you cannot patch what you did not know you had.
Because it proves the build is reproducible.
options_ar: لأنه يشفّر كل تبعية غير مباشرة.
لأنك ما تقدر ترقّع شي ما تعرف إنه عندك.
لأنه يثبت إن البناء قابل للإعادة.
options_en: Because it satisfies the audit requirement only.
Because it encrypts every transitive dependency.
Because you cannot patch what you did not know you had.
Because it proves the build is reproducible.
questions.explanation: When a widely used library is disclosed as vulnerable, the inventory is what tells you whether you are exposed within minutes or weeks.
questions.explanation_ar: لمّا تُكشف مكتبة واسعة الاستخدام كضعيفة، الجرد هو اللي يقولك إنك متعرّض خلال دقائق أو أسابيع.

questions.question: Which cloud-native weakness does the chapter name first?
questions.question_ar: أي ضعف سحابي المنشأ يذكره الفصل أولاً؟
options: Container misconfigurations.
Container image compression errors.
Container network address exhaustion.
Container clock synchronisation drift.
options_en: Container misconfigurations.
Container image compression errors.
Container network address exhaustion.
Container clock synchronisation drift.
questions.explanation: The image is usually fine; what is wrong is how it was configured and what it was granted when it ran.
questions.explanation_ar: الصورة عادةً سليمة؛ الغلط بإعدادها وبالصلاحيات اللي انمنحتها لمّا اشتغلت.

questions.question: What does insecure orchestration refer to?
questions.question_ar: إلى شنو تشير الحوكمة غير الآمنة للتنسيق؟
options: Slow scheduling of pods across the cluster.
Missing backups of the persistent volumes.
Excessive logging from the control plane.
Exposure of the orchestration API such as Kubernetes.
options_en: Slow scheduling of pods across the cluster.
Missing backups of the persistent volumes.
Excessive logging from the control plane.
Exposure of the orchestration API such as Kubernetes.
questions.explanation: An exposed control plane API hands the attacker cluster-level power, which is far beyond any single application flaw.
questions.explanation_ar: واجهة تحكّم مكشوفة تعطي المهاجم سلطة على مستوى العنقود، وهذا أبعد بكثير من أي عيب تطبيق منفرد.

questions.question: Which weakness is specific to serverless platforms?
questions.question_ar: أي ضعف خاص بمنصّات serverless؟
options: Image layer tampering.
Event injection.
Container escape.
Pod scheduling abuse.
options_en: Image layer tampering.
Event injection.
Container escape.
Pod scheduling abuse.
questions.explanation: Functions are triggered by events, so a crafted event payload becomes the injection vector that a request body would be elsewhere.
questions.explanation_ar: الدوال تُشغَّل بأحداث، فحمولة حدث مُصمَّمة تصير ناقل الحقن اللي يكون جسم الطلب بمكان ثاني.

questions.question: Why does moving to serverless not remove configuration risk?
questions.question_ar: ليش الانتقال لـserverless ما يزيل خطر الإعداد؟
options: Because serverless functions cannot be monitored.
Because serverless removes all authentication needs.
Because the provider secures the platform, not your settings.
Because providers refuse to patch their own hosts.
options_ar: لأن دوال serverless ما يمكن مراقبتها.
لأن serverless تلغي كل حاجة للمصادقة.
لأن المزوّد يؤمّن المنصّة مو إعداداتك.
options_en: Because serverless functions cannot be monitored.
Because serverless removes all authentication needs.
Because the provider secures the platform, not your settings.
Because providers refuse to patch their own hosts.
questions.explanation: The shared responsibility boundary puts the runtime on the provider and the identity, permissions and input handling firmly on you.
questions.explanation_ar: حدّ المسؤولية المشتركة يضع وقت التشغيل على المزوّد والهوية والصلاحيات ومعالجة المدخلات عليك أنت.

questions.question: Which control does the chapter give for container images?
questions.question_ar: أي ضابط يعطيه الفصل لصور الحاويات؟
options: Image scanning.
Image compression.
Image versioning.
Image encryption.
options_en: Image scanning.
Image compression.
Image versioning.
Image encryption.
questions.explanation: Scanning inspects the layers and packages baked into the image before it is allowed to run.
questions.explanation_ar: الفحص يفتّش الطبقات والحزم المخبوزة بالصورة قبل ما يُسمح لها تشتغل.

questions.question: Where is policy enforced for orchestrated workloads?
questions.question_ar: وين تُفرض السياسة على أحمال العمل المنسَّقة؟
options: In the developer's local editor.
In the load balancer configuration.
In the DNS resolver zone file.
In the orchestration platform itself.
options_en: In the developer's local editor.
In the load balancer configuration.
In the DNS resolver zone file.
In the orchestration platform itself.
questions.explanation: The orchestrator is the only place that sees every workload before it starts, which is why admission policy belongs there.
questions.explanation_ar: المنسّق هو المكان الوحيد اللي يشوف كل حِمل قبل ما يبدأ، ولهذا سياسة القبول تنتمي هناك.

questions.question: Why do dynamic architectures complicate vulnerability management?
questions.question_ar: ليش المعماريات الديناميكية تعقّد إدارة الثغرات؟
options: Because they run only during business hours.
Because the exposure profile changes continuously.
Because they forbid automated scanning entirely.
Because they store no logs of any kind.
options_en: Because they run only during business hours.
Because the exposure profile changes continuously.
Because they forbid automated scanning entirely.
Because they store no logs of any kind.
questions.explanation: Workloads appear and disappear faster than a periodic scan cycle, so a snapshot is stale before the report is written.
questions.explanation_ar: الأحمال تظهر وتختفي أسرع من دورة فحص دورية، فالصورة تصير قديمة قبل ما يُكتب التقرير.

questions.question: What makes these modern classes different from classic web flaws?
questions.question_ar: شنو يخلي هذي الفئات الحديثة مختلفة عن العيوب الكلاسيكية؟
options: They can only be exploited by insiders.
They are all prevented by a web application firewall.
They arise from architecture and dependencies, not bad input.
They only affect applications written in JavaScript.
options_ar: كلها يمنعها جدار حماية تطبيقات الويب.
تنشأ من المعمارية والتبعيات، مو من مدخل سيئ.
تؤثّر فقط على التطبيقات المكتوبة بـJavaScript.
options_en: They can only be exploited by insiders.
They are all prevented by a web application firewall.
They arise from architecture and dependencies, not bad input.
They only affect applications written in JavaScript.
questions.explanation: You cannot encode or validate your way out of a poisoned dependency or an exposed control plane, so the fix is architectural.
questions.explanation_ar: ما تقدر تعالج تبعية مسمومة أو واجهة تحكّم مكشوفة بالترميز أو التحقّق، فالإصلاح معماري.
